syllabus_topics: Introduction (Explanation of the course assessment method. Recap of key concepts from Ethics I concerning human action and the practical use of reason.)
Ethics in Modernity. Hume's emotivist Ethics.
Person and Society. Ethics and social behavior.
The dimensions of the Human Person.
The knowledge of GOOD and TRUTH. Kantian Formal Ethics.
Foundations of Relativism and comparison with Socratic Ethics
Love and its articulation in the various spheres of life
The Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society. Film analysis.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary examination, the course exam accounts for 80% and term assignments for 20%. The extraordinary examination consists of a course exam, without further specified weighting.
